title: ci(docs-deploy): deploy the Object UI docs site (www.objectui.org) from ui/apps/site
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoE27UVDXhUp74pztDpSVFdR)_

Part of #26993. This PR carries the code half. The card stays open for its proof: one `workflow_dispatch` run of the new job on `main` that prints the deployment URL, after the maintainer action below. Tier H (`.github/workflows/**`): draft until green, GOVERNED_APPROVERS review it, the maintainer merges, and no seat enqueues it.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:根仓 `.github/workflows/docs-deploy.yml` 加第二个作业 `Deploy objectui docs to Vercel (production)`,和现有 `apps/docs` 作业同一套做法(runner 上 `vercel pull` → `vercel build --prod` → `vercel deploy --prebuilt --prod`),部署 `ui/apps/site` 到 Vercel 项目 `objectui`(www.objectui.org)。原 `apps/docs` 作业一个字没改。
- **为什么改**:objectui 仓自己的部署 workflow 随 `ui/.github/workflows/` 一起删了,`ui/apps/site/vercel.json` 又关了 Git 自动部署,所以合并后没有任何流程发布 www.objectui.org,18.2 之后的文档改动都上不了线。
- **风险与回滚**:只在 `main` 上按定时(每 6 小时)或手动触发运行,不影响任何 PR 检查。两个作业互相独立,新作业红了不影响 `apps/docs` 的部署。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`.github/workflows/docs-deploy.yml` 末尾的 `deploy-ui-site` 作业,重点看 "Require the project's Root Directory to be ui/apps/site" 这一步和 build 步骤不带 token 的写法。
- **两分钟验证**:合并后在 Actions 页对 Docs Deploy 点 "Run workflow"(选 `main`)。Root Directory 改好之前,新作业会在 Root Directory 那一步红,报错里写明要改的设置;改好之后应该绿,并在 summary 里打印部署 URL。
- **需要你做的**:在 Vercel 控制台把项目 `objectui`(`prj_v1rXIczaI7YGmXmseQCLFUFOFxTB`)的 Settings → Build and Deployment → Root Directory 从 `apps/site` 改成 `ui/apps/site`,然后批准合并本 PR。

## What changes

- `.github/workflows/docs-deploy.yml`:
  - The header now names both sites and says the two jobs are independent.
  - New job `deploy-ui-site`, named `Deploy objectui docs to Vercel (production)`. It keeps the shape of the existing `deploy` job:
    - the same refusal steps: a ref other than `main`, then a missing `VERCEL_TOKEN`, each an `::error::` and a red run;
    - checkout and `./.github/actions/setup-workspace`;
    - `vercel pull` → `vercel build --prod` → `vercel deploy --prebuilt --prod`, all run from the repository root;
    - the same pinned `VERCEL_CLI_VERSION` (`60.1.3`) and the same team id; the project id is objectui's old one, `prj_v1rXIczaI7YGmXmseQCLFUFOFxTB`;
    - the post-build assertions against `ui/apps/site/.next/BUILD_ID` and `.vercel/output/config.json`;
    - the step-summary line with the deployment URL.
  - Two differences from `deploy`, both explained in the job's header:
    - A step after `vercel pull` reads `settings.rootDirectory` from the `.vercel/project.json` the pull wrote. It goes red, naming the dashboard setting and the value it needs, unless that reads `ui/apps/site`. The project's setting still reads `apps/site` from when the site lived in objectui. Without this step that would fail later inside `vercel build`, with an error that does not name the cause.
    - `vercel build` gets no `VERCEL_TOKEN`. Only `pull` and `deploy` call the Vercel API. This is the card's ask and objectui's original choice: the build runs every workspace package's lifecycle scripts.
  - Not ported, per the card: objectui's pinned-@objectstack restore, build and save steps. Every @objectstack package the site imports is a workspace package here.
- The `deploy` job (apps/docs) is byte-for-byte unchanged.
- `ui/apps/site/vercel.json` is unchanged. Its commands work in the merged layout, as measured below.

## Tests

Cold local build of the exact production command, run the way Vercel runs it (cwd `ui/apps/site`, then `cd ../..`):

<details><summary>`pnpm turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/site` from `ui/`, head 137ca903</summary>

- `turbo run --dry=json` from `ui/` resolved this repository's root and scheduled the site with its whole closure: 67 build tasks, 30 in @object-ui packages and 37 in @objectstack packages (65 of them have work to do, per the run below).
- The real run at `--concurrency=2`, under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`: `Tasks: 65 successful, 65 total` · `Cached: 0 cached, 65 total` · `WALL 596s EXIT 0`.
- `ui/apps/site/.next/BUILD_ID` was written.
- `pnpm exec turbo --version` reads 2.11.5 from both the root and `ui/`, so the `cd ../..` into `ui/` does not pick up a different turbo.

</details>

The YAML parses: the jobs are `deploy` and `deploy-ui-site`, with 10 steps in the new job.

CI-only families are read from this PR's check-runs.

NOT MEASURED, and what proves it:

- `vercel pull`, the Root Directory step's reading of `.vercel/project.json` and the upload. They need `VERCEL_TOKEN`, which this container does not have. The `settings.rootDirectory` key is what the CLI's `pull` writes. The first `workflow_dispatch` run on `main` after the merge is the proof the card asks for.
- Whether the organization's `VERCEL_TOKEN` can deploy to the `objectui` project. The token belongs to the same team as the `objectstack` project. This is part of the card's maintainer action.

## Acceptance notes

- **No PR job builds `@object-ui/site`.** The card allowed adding one to a ui lane, or saying why not. Not added, for three reasons:
  - The build is the whole site closure: 65 tasks, 596 s cold on 2 workers here. `Build UI Deps` hands the ui jobs only its seven @objectstack packages, so the site's other 30 @objectstack packages and its @object-ui packages would build cold in every ui PR's run. That is a new advisory lane on the hottest filter.
  - A broken site build is not silent. The deploy job reds at most six hours after it lands on `main`, and "Run workflow" re-checks it at once.
  - The lane can be added later as one job, if the maintainer wants deploys predicted per PR. That choice is left on #26993 and on #26717's row 7 rather than taken here.
- `ui/content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md` still describes objectui's deleted `docs-deploy.yml` (its cron, its secret table row). That page's rewrite or retirement is #26944, so it is not touched here.
